input.summary:
Loft lit: 10 lanterns added at the end of parts/room-14.mjs (3 standing on the floor, 6 hanging under the z 8/25/30 tie beams and the 25 beam). mcd room: 0 dark cells, min 7, 6 dim cells left at 7.
make.sh builds whole build.nbt; Loft walks 1097/1097 and no other room was touched.
Four rebuild rounds were needed because each mcd room call lists only three lamp spots.
left: 6 floor cells in the Loft stay at light 7 (dim, not dark). The remaining mcd suggestions lift 1-2 cells each, so I stopped there; a designer can accept that or ask for more.
Suggested hanging lantern at 11,21,25 was not added: the lantern at 11,22,25 already sits in that column, and the tool does not treat a lantern as support.
Whole-build mcd walk reports ok:false because Pocket A1-A3 and B1-B3 are 'UNREACHABLE: no way in'. Those are outside the Loft and were not touched.
mcd check reports orphan smooth_stone_slab cells at 15,5,6 / 15,5,7 / 11,5,30 / 11,5,31 (ground floor, not mine).

waste.what: Re-reading the ASCII light map by hand and choosing lamp cells one round at a time: four edit-make-check cycles, each adding three lamps from the top of the list.
waste.cost: 4 rebuilds of about 20 s each, plus 10 hand-written lantern set() lines and 4 full light-map reads.
waste.tool: mcd room --only Loft --lamps N (or --apply) should run the greedy placement itself and print a finished g.set list covering every dim cell with the fewest lamps, instead of the top three spots per call.

waste.what: Confirming that each hanging lantern hangs from a real block: a lantern set at y 22 under a tie beam at y 23 needed a separate check of the beam's cells.
waste.cost: 2 extra reads of the beam layout.
waste.tool: mcd room's lamp list should mark each spot as hanging from a named block or standing on one, and the tool should not suggest a lantern under another lantern.
